statement: Wired LED brightness and RGBW override now have bounded physical evidence: key 45 brightness and C5 four-byte red/green/blue/white stimuli 25 gated by key 37=1. E9 returned four zeros at the tested values; its cause and higher-value behavior remain untested. Calibrated transfer, full ranges, reset/restart persistence, player identities, Puck/receiver and Bluetooth output control remain unmeasured.

applicability.scope: Evidence gap only; source and physical requirements described in docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md.
